tasks.name: Fence managed assignments during handoff
tasks.description: R2/R4/R5/R6/R9. Add durable per-assignment handoff and normal-mutation exclusion in existing workspace DB. Keep lifecycle union and ordinary bind unchanged. New handoff.ts exports beginHandoff(db,input), transferHandoff(db,input), finishHandoff(db,input), withAssignmentMutation(db,guid,operation,fn). Input carries repositoryPath, repositoryIdentity, workspaceGuid, workerId, sourceOwnerSessionId, generation, capabilityToken, expectedWorktreePath/Branch/BaseCommit/CurrentHead/IntegrationTarget; transfer adds targetOwnerSessionId. Authorization grants scoped token hash from Commander private control transport, not public tool. Compare full tuple and fresh canonical Git evidence; no primary owner/integration/rebase/active mutation. New tables additive: workspace_handoffs keyed GUID with generation/token_hash/source_owner/target_owner/evidence/phase; workspace_mutations keyed GUID with operation/nonce/process identity. Normal mutation atomically excludes unfinished hold; hold excludes live or unreconciled mutation. Never expire holds. Wrap all existing assignment mutations before first Git/filesystem effect, including finalizeCommanderLocalCommit, finalizeDirectAuthority, finalizeReconcile, finalizeConfirmResolution, finalizeCloseOut, reconcileFinalization, resolveConflictHunk, syncWorktreeToTarget, recycleFinalized/releaseFinalized and service abandon/cleanup/reap/checkout switching/shared relinks. Nested calls reuse only current operation token internally. Transfer owner CAS and revoke unconsumed source human_intents; preserved_work obligations follow owner. Hold remains after owner transfer until finish. Wrong capability/source/destination/evidence/status rejects before mutation.
